description: This file defines a Java class named Address, which models address information including city, postal code, state/province, zone, and country. It provides standard getters and setters for these fields.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: A model class representing an address with fields for city, postal code, state/province, zone, and country, implementing Serializable.
